title: Jib Up
description: A jib up camera is a short rising arm that gives a table or face back to the room, human-scale lift. Who else is present appears; a skyline does not have to.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Leave the face, keep the architecture small. Endings of talks, a stand-up, a reveal of who else is in the room.
Intimate lift, not a city crane-up. If the background does not parallax, the arm did not move: you tilted.
A Technocrane that finds a skyline is a different scale. One axis, a short rise, a near object shearing.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Short jib, start on the subject, end with the room. Parallax of a near object (table edge, lamp, shoulder).
Prompt: Jib up from [Subject], a short rising arm, the table or face giving the room back, human-scale lift.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a tilt up. The tell: no shear of a table or lamp, only a change of angle.
The fix: boom a short arm, let a near object slide, end on the room.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Jib Up in film?
A jib up is a short rising crane arm that leaves a face or table and gives the room back. Human-scale lift, not a city climb.
Jib Up vs Crane Up
A crane-up can rise and ease back until a person is geography. A jib up is a few feet, revealing who else is in the room.
When should I use Jib Up?
Use it to leave a face and show the rest of a small space. Do not use it when the world must become a skyline.
How do I prompt Jib Up for AI image or video?
Write a short rising arm and a room reveal. Example: Jib up from [Subject], a short rising arm, the table or face giving the room back, human-scale lift.
